title: The NROL-16 patch and Ron Pandolfi

tellings.quote: continued into the 21st century. In a presentation, former CIA officer John Ramirez described one particular case, the 2005 launch of NROL 16.

plain: Michels says that a former CIA officer named John Ramirez, in a presentation, described the 2005 launch of NROL-16, a satellite mission of the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites, as a case of something from earlier history continuing "into the 21st century". The case centres on the mission's patch and on a man named Ron Pandolfi, whom Ramirez connects to it. Michels relays this from Ramirez's talk, in an episode on hidden ritual and secret science around the space programme.
